data.name: Kiribati
data.summary: Kiribati (Income Tax Act 2023) taxes residents on worldwide income at up to 30% above AUD 30,000. Foreign dividends are property income at those rates with a foreign tax credit. Whether private capital gains on shares are taxed, and the rate of the final withholding on Kiribati dividends, were not found: both are left unknown. No inheritance, gift or wealth tax was found. Low confidence overall.

regimes.name: Ordinary tax residence
regimes.description: Residents taxed on worldwide income at 0/20/25/30%.
regimes.eligibility: Resident: permanent home available in Kiribati, or 183 days' presence in any 12 months beginning or ending in the year (Income Tax Act 2023, per the 2023 return instructions).

capital_gains.summary: Not established. The 2023 return instructions tax profits on disposal of business assets (other business income) and treat 'profits on disposal or surrender of a financial instrument' as interest; whether a private investor's gains on listed shares or real estate are taxable under the Income Tax Act 2023 was not found.

dividends.summary: Residents are taxed on income from all sources (return instructions, Question 19). Dividends are property income (Box 26A) taxed at resident rates: 0% to AUD 5,000, 20% to 15,000, 25% to 30,000, 30% above. Overseas tax on property income is credited separately (Q25). A dividend from a Kiribati resident company from which tax was withheld need not be returned (final withholding; rate not found).
dividends.exemptions_thresholds: Resident scale (2023 return): nil to AUD 5,000; 20% on 5,000-15,000; AUD 2,000 + 25% on 15,000-30,000; AUD 5,750 + 30% above 30,000. Non-residents 30% flat.

residency.tax_residency_test: Income Tax Act 2023 (per the 2023 individual return instructions): resident if a permanent home is available in Kiribati, or present for periods adding up to 183 days in any 12-month period beginning or ending in the tax year, or a citizen official posted overseas. Residents are taxed on worldwide income.

data.us_citizen_notes: US citizens remain subject to US federal income, estate and gift tax on worldwide income and assets wherever they live; the app adds the federal layer. Where local tax on portfolio income is nil there is nothing to credit against US tax.
